candidates.instruction: Keep the 32-bit counter, its increment and explicit `counter == 32'd255` rollover branch unchanged. Replace only `pwm_out <= (counter < {24'd0, duty});` with the equivalent condition `pwm_out <= ((counter[31:8] == 0) && (counter[7:0] < duty));`. Preserve reset and registered-output behavior; promote only if all deterministic gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below 7 with setup and hold slack both nonnegative.
